verdict.rationale: Postman's docs say the Postman CLI runs collections 'with extensive configuration options and built-in reporters,' including test collections in CI/CD pipelines. Newman also runs and tests collections from the command line, and collection scripts perform API tests. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the pass/fail report contents or format (the evidence only says 'built-in reporters'), and independent or hands-on corroboration of collection-level automated test runs.
